reason: The ₹1,999 a month I can manage easily, that is not the problem. Washing at home is free, the women have always done it, and this is still semi-automatic, so they would be standing next to it moving clothes to the spinner anyway. I don't see why I should start paying every month for something we already manage.
objection: Hand-washing costs nothing and it gets done. A semi-automatic still needs someone standing beside it, and I'm not sure a battery in a machine that sits in water lasts in our village, or what a new battery costs after 3 years.
would_change_my_mind: If my wife asked for it properly, or I saw it working in a neighbour's house through our power cuts for a few months without trouble, I would take it on EMI from the dealer.
